source: Tony McGovern, US County Level Election Results 08-24 (github.com/tonmcg), compiled from official state tallies; 2024 presidential election
measure: Margin in percentage points of the two-party vote: Trump share minus Harris share, red for a Republican lead and blue for a Democratic lead. State values sum the county votes. Alaska reports by state house district and Connecticut by planning region, so their counties carry no value.
